name: Tung Tung Tung Sahur
blurb: An AI-made wooden drum creature with a bat from Indonesia, the star of 2025 brainrot
title: Tung Tung Tung Sahur Meme: Meaning, Origin & Trend
description: Tung Tung Tung Sahur is an AI-generated wooden figure with a bat, posted on TikTok in February 2025 by Indonesian creator Noxa.
h1: What is the Tung Tung Tung Sahur meme?
answer: Tung Tung Tung Sahur is an AI-generated character: a wooden figure with a face, arms and legs, holding a baseball bat. Indonesian TikToker Noxa (@noxaasht) posted it on 28 February 2025, the day before Ramadan began in Indonesia, and it gained more than 31 million views in a month. The name copies the "tung tung" sound of the wooden drum used to wake people for sahur, the pre-dawn Ramadan meal, and the character became one of the best-known faces of Italian brainrot.

body: The character is an anthropomorphic kentongan, a traditional Indonesian wooden slit drum, standing upright with a face, arms and legs and gripping a bat, which in Indonesian is a pentungan, the stick used to beat the drum. In the original clip an Indonesian narrator repeats "tung tung tung… sahur" and explains, in mock-horror style, that if you are called for sahur three times and do not answer, he comes to your house.

body.note: The image was made with an AI image generator and the voice is synthetic narration. The joke is a spooky twist on a real custom: in Indonesia, the kentongan was traditionally struck before dawn in Ramadan to wake residents for sahur.

head: Date
Event
rows: Noxa posts the AI image on TikTok as part of an Indonesian "AI anomaly character" trend; it passes 31 million views within a month.
Remixes, drawings and "who would win" videos against Brr Brr Patapim spread; the character is absorbed into the Italian brainrot cast.
The character disappears from the Roblox game Steal a Brainrot (around 13 September) amid a licensing dispute involving Mementum Lab, an agency representing Noxa.
The game's makers file a US federal lawsuit arguing that an AI-generated character cannot be copyrighted; the agency counterclaims.
After a trailer on 18 March, Fortnite sells a Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin from 3 April; many players criticise it for being AI-made.

ul: Typing or chanting "tung tung tung sahur" as a jump-scare or a wake-up call, especially during Ramadan.
Powerscaling battles: Tung Tung Tung Sahur versus Brr Brr Patapim, Tralalero Tralala and other brainrot characters.
Fan lore, such as the storyline where Ballerina Cappuccina cheats on Cappuccino Assassino with him.
Drawings, clay figures, costumes and Roblox avatars; it even appeared on a police rest-stop display in East Java during the holiday travel season.

body: It is past its 2025 viral peak but remains the most recognisable brainrot character, with game skins and merchandise. Who controls it commercially is disputed: Noxa and his representatives say the work behind the image gives him copyright, while others argue AI-made images are not protected. The US lawsuit over its use in Steal a Brainrot has not been decided.

faq.a: Sahur is the meal Muslims eat before dawn during Ramadan. "Tung tung" imitates the drum people beat to wake others for it.

faq.q: Who created Tung Tung Tung Sahur?
faq.a: Indonesian TikToker Noxa (@noxaasht), who posted the AI-generated image on 28 February 2025.

faq.q: Is Tung Tung Tung Sahur Italian?
faq.a: No. It comes from Indonesia and the narration is in Indonesian, but fans treat it as part of the Italian brainrot family.
